title: Eleven Pounds at a Time
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：wealth　|　正文 312 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wealth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My great-grandfather had ① wealth by the standards of that street and no money, which my father said was impossible and which anybody who has kept a shop will understand, and no wealth, he said, survives being counted. The ② wealth he cared about was not having it but being seen to have it, and he said the second costs eleven times as much and lasts eleven times as long.

The ③ wealth of the village in 1931, counting the land, the stock and the eleven houses, was about four thousand pounds; the county's record says so, and the county's record is wrong by half. There is a ④ wealth of detail in his ledger: who paid on the Thursday, who paid in eggs, and who never paid at all.

He never ⑤ accumulated wealth in the way the word is used, because he did not keep it: he lent it, eleven pounds at a time, to people who mostly paid him back, and mostly not in money. The ⑥ wealth of information in those eleven ledgers is the reason anybody knows anything at all about that street.

The ⑦ wealth gap in the village in 1961 was eleven pounds a week, which sounds like nothing and was the difference between meat on Sunday and meat on Thursday. He had by then a ⑧ wealth of experience in lending, and the whole of it came down to one rule: lend to a man who is ashamed, and never to a man who is not.

The ⑨ wealth he left, when he died in 1968, was eleven pounds in the bank, eleven ledgers, and four hundred pounds owed to him, of which my grandmother collected eleven, and the wealth was never in the bank. The ⑩ wealth she had, and she had some, was that she never had to ask anybody for anything, and she said that was the only kind there is.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 富裕；富足（状态）
C. n. （一地的）财力；资产总值
D. 固定搭配：a wealth of ... 大量的……；丰富的……
E. 固定搭配：accumulate / build up wealth 积累财富
F. 固定搭配：the wealth of ... ……的大量／丰富
G. 固定搭配：wealth gap 贫富差距；财富差距
H. 固定搭配：wealth of experience 丰富的经验

items.q: The wealth of the village in 1931
There is a wealth of detail
The wealth of information in those eleven
The wealth gap in the village
He had by then a wealth of experience
The wealth he left, when he died
The wealth she had, and she had some

answers.why: wealth 意为“财富、财产”，按那条街的标准，曾祖父是有财富的，可他身上没有钱。
the wealth 意为“富裕、富足（这种状态）”，他在意的不是有钱，而是被人看见有钱。
the wealth of the village 意为“这个村子的财力、资产总值”，1931 年算上土地、存货和十一栋房子约四千镑。
a wealth of ... 意为“大量的……、丰富的……”，他的账簿里有极其丰富的细节。
accumulate wealth 意为“积累财富”，他从未以这个词通常的意思积累过财富，因为他不存钱。
the wealth of information 意为“信息之丰富、大量的信息”，那十一本账簿里信息之丰富，是后人对那条街有所了解的全部原因。
wealth gap 意为“贫富差距、财富差距”，1961 年村里的贫富差距是每周十一镑。
wealth of experience 意为“丰富的经验”，到那时他已有十分丰富的放贷经验。
the wealth 意为“遗产、财产”，他 1968 年去世时留下的财产是银行里的十一镑、十一本账簿。
the wealth 意为“富足、富裕（的状态）”，她所拥有的那种富足是：她从未开口向任何人要过任何东西。
